{"title": "SOC 2 A1 — Availability | Compliance Dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "## SOC 2 — A1: Availability

**Trust Services Criterion:** The entity maintains availability of its information and systems to meet its service commitments and system requirements.

| Sub-Criterion | Audit Focus | Wazuh Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **A1.1** | System processing capacity is managed to meet availability commitments and system requirements | Agent health monitoring, disconnection/reconnection tracking |
| **A1.2** | Environmental protections, software, data backup, and recovery infrastructure support availability | System monitoring continuity, agent uptime evidence |

**Data Source:** Wazuh agent lifecycle events — disconnection alerts (rule 503), reconnection events (rules 504/505), and system health monitoring.  
**Default Evidence Period:** Last 90 days (SOC 2 Type 2 examination window)"}}
